modules.goal: compute Switch Transformer and Router Z-loss for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
modules.rationale: Combining fractional token-dispatch load balancing with router logsumexp z-loss keeps all experts active without numerical overflow:
modules.code:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def moe_router_losses(router_logits: torch.Tensor, top_indices: torch.Tensor, n_experts: int) -> torch.Tensor:
    probs = F.softmax(router_logits, dim=-1)
    mean_prob = probs.mean(dim=(0, 1))
    one_hot = F.one_hot(top_indices, num_classes=n_experts).float()
    frac_routed = one_hot.mean(dim=(0, 1, 2))
    balance_loss = (mean_prob * frac_routed).sum() * n_experts
    z_loss = (torch.logsumexp(router_logits, dim=-1) ** 2).mean() * 1e-3
    return balance_loss + z_loss

modules.goal: implement grouped query attention GQA with QK-RMSNorm and rotary embeddings
modules.rationale: Normalizing query and key heads with RMSNorm before RoPE rotation prevents attention logit spikes in deep 12-layer MoE transformers:
modules.code:
import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class QKNormGQA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model: int, n_heads: int = 8, n_kv_heads: int = 2):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_heads = n_heads
        self.n_kv_heads = n_kv_heads
        self.group_size = n_heads // n_kv_heads
        self.head_dim = d_model // n_heads
        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(d_model, n_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(d_model, n_kv_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(d_model, n_kv_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
        self.out_proj = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        b, t, d = x.size()
        q = self.q_proj(x).view(b, t, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        k = self.k_proj(x).view(b, t, self.n_kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        v = self.v_proj(x).view(b, t, self.n_kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        q = q * torch.rsqrt(q.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
        k = k * torch.rsqrt(k.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
        k = k.repeat_interleave(self.group_size, dim=1)
        v = v.repeat_interleave(self.group_size, dim=1)
        scores = (q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)
        mask = torch.tril(torch.ones(t, t, device=x.device)).view(1, 1, t, t)
        attn = F.softmax(scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, float('-inf')), dim=-1)
        return self.out_proj((attn @ v).transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(b, t, d))
